standard.coverage: All employers. Nevada's two-tier system (a lower rate for employers offering qualifying health benefits) was ABOLISHED by the 2022 constitutional amendment -- a table still carrying two Nevada rates is out of date.
standard.note: Nev. Const. art. 15 sec. 16 as amended by Question 2 (2022).

tipped.note: This state allows NO tip credit: the full state minimum wage must be paid in cash before any tips. Nevada has never permitted a tip credit.

indexation.note: Question 2 (2022) REPEALED Nevada's annual cost-of-living adjustment effective 2024-07-01, alongside abolishing the two tiers. The rate now moves only by constitutional amendment, or upward if the federal rate ever exceeds $12.00. This is why Nevada has been flat at $12.00 through two July cycles while its neighbours indexed.
